en: An official beige postal card formatted as a telephone bill or payment notice. The left side lists numbered fee items and handwritten amounts in purple ink, while the right side has printed headings and lines filled in with handwritten recipient information. There are several stamps and postmarks, including circular black postmarks and a red handstamp with the date "1. IX. 1933". The printed language is Estonian; words like "AMETLIK POSTKAART" (Official Postcard) and "EESTI" appear, along with handwritten place names such as "Pürksi" or "Pürsale" and "Risti".
